name: Teddy Sketch A
implementation_status: proposal only; not wired into inherited playable

right_button_resolution.quick_release: heavy only when fists are up, hands free and legal; no outcome on unavailable hand
right_button_resolution.hold: commit reach preview after tap threshold; no automatic heavy on release
right_button_resolution.pickup_future: item latches at acquisition; originating release is consumed
right_button_resolution.sustained_attachment_future: person or climb/vault node requires continued hold
right_button_resolution.throwable_future: subsequent hold plus wheel up enters wind; release produces authored power/arc

guard.actual_coverage: depends on hand occupancy, stance, facing and active phase

parry: eligible light-hand interception; raising guard is ordinary defense, not parry
rebind_policy: raw events normalized to semantic actions; profile import/export; same semantic trace has same mechanical outcome; ergonomic feel may differ
